lines.text: She was over the moon about the news.

data.define: Used when you are very, very pleased.

example.text: She was over the moon about the news.

misuse.text: Don't say 'over the moon' about space travel.

publish.title: What does "over the moon" mean?
publish.value: Over the moon = Extremely happy. Example: "She was over the moon about the news." (casual English, UK).
